verdict: Yes, if you can make comfort your whole brand. Bummer pitched quirky, super-soft innerwear on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Innerwear is bought again and again and is rarely returned, which is ideal for a D2C brand. The hard part is standing out against Jockey and many funded competitors, so pick one audience and one fabric story.
angle: Innerwear is a repeat purchase with almost no fashion risk and hygiene rules that keep returns low. Kolkata and Tiruppur can make it in small runs. Buyers are open to new brands for comfort, fun prints or sustainable fabrics like modal and bamboo, but ad costs are high, so bundles and subscriptions matter.

faq_extra.q: Can you return innerwear bought online in India?
faq_extra.a: Most brands don't accept returns on opened innerwear for hygiene reasons, which is one reason margins are better than in other clothing. Clear size charts are still essential.
